criteria: 브랜드 19곳(Gucci + pool.json competitor_set 18곳)에 동일한 질의 템플릿 ("영문명" OR "현지어명") when:7d 를 권역별 에디션마다 1회씩 실행
권역 에디션: NEA=KR/ko·JP/ja·HK/zh, SEA=TH/th·SG/en, NA=US/en, EU=GB/en·FR/fr·IT/it; 동일 깊이(RSS 1페이지, 에디션당 최대 100건)
발행일이 2026-11-09~2026-11-15 안에 확인되는 기사만 집계; 권역 안에서 제목 정규화로 중복 제거

criteria_en: Same query template ("English name" OR "local alias") when:7d, once per brand per edition, for 19 brands (Gucci + 18 competitor_set houses)
Editions: NEA=KR/ko, JP/ja, HK/zh; SEA=TH/th, SG/en; NA=US/en; EU=GB/en, FR/fr, IT/it; identical depth (one RSS page, max 100 items per edition)
Only articles dated 2026-11-09 to 2026-11-15; de-duplicated by normalised title within a block
Script-counted (scripts/collect_sov.py): search depth is identical per brand by construction; outlets and two example links kept as evidence

audit_notes: Spot-check PASS (title/outlet-level verification; Google News RSS redirect URLs do not resolve to article bodies via fetch tools, so verification relied on RSS title+outlet metadata, consistent with how collect_sov.py itself parses evidence).
NEA/Gucci (Vogue Korea "Gucci x Mariah Carey 2026 holiday" + Newspim Gucci-vs-Coach consumer piece): on-topic, within window, outlets reputable. PASS.
NA/Burberry (WSJ "shares jump after sales" + Reuters "entry-level luxury lures new buyers", via Yahoo Finance/WWD/FT/Reuters/WSJ outlets): on-topic, within window. PASS.

EU/Valentino FLAGGED: outlets list is ["Motorcycle Sports","MotoGP News","Corriere della Sera","Crash.net","Paddock GP","GPblog"] - 5 of 6 are motorsport press; one of two example titles ("Valentino Rossi feared his daughter would share Marc Marquez’s birthday - Crash.net") is unambiguously about the MotoGP rider Valentino Rossi, not the fashion brand. This is a brand-name collision in the query ("Valentino" matches Valentino Rossi coverage), not a script bug - the script ran the identical symmetric query for all brands. Same moto-outlet contamination also present in SEA (4/6 outlets) and NA (4/6 outlets) Valentino evidence; NEA/Valentino is clean (0/6 moto outlets). Net effect: EU Valentino count of 193 (currently ranked #1 in EU, ahead of Dior at 153) is likely materially inflated by non-fashion Valentino Rossi coverage and should be treated with caution; counts left unmodified per audit policy (no hand-adjustment).
